entries.text: There’s not much space for your Pokémon.\nDoesn’t seem like you can host a picnic...
entries.label: pokepicnic_main_error_01

entries.text: Your things might slide off the table if you try\nto have a picnic on a slope like this!
entries.label: pokepicnic_main_error_02

entries.text: There’s not quite enough space to unpack your\nPicnic Set and let your Pokémon play freely...
entries.label: pokepicnic_main_error_03

entries.text: Probably best not to host a picnic here...
entries.label: pokepicnic_main_error_04

entries.text: Probably best not to host a picnic in a spot\nso close to people...
entries.label: pokepicnic_main_error_05

entries.text: Seems like you can’t hold a picnic on the water...
entries.label: pokepicnic_main_error_07

entries.text: You can’t set up a picnic while riding a Pokémon!
entries.label: pokepicnic_main_error_08

entries.text: It’s a Picnic Set! What do you want to do?
entries.label: pokepicnic_main_set_01

entries.text: You’ve still got company! Are you sure you want\nto pack up?
entries.label: pokepicnic_main_friend_04

entries.text: What do you want to change up?

entries.text: Which tablecloth do you want to put out?

entries.text: Uh-oh, you’ve run out of picks! You can’t make a\nsandwich like this!

entries.text: Oh no, you don’t have enough ingredients to\njoin in the sandwich making...
entries.label: pokepicnic_main_cooking_message_03

entries.text: Someone else is using the table to make\nsandwiches now! Let’s wait our turn.
entries.label: pokepicnic_main_cooking_message_04

entries.text: There’s a Pokémon Egg inside! Do you want to\ntake it?
entries.label: pokepicnic_main_tamago_02

entries.text: It’s another Pokémon Egg! Do you want to\ntake it?
entries.label: pokepicnic_main_tamago_02_02

entries.text: In that case, the Egg will be sent to the academy\nfor someone else to care for. Is that OK?
entries.label: pokepicnic_main_tamago_03

entries.text: The Egg was sent to the academy!
entries.label: pokepicnic_main_tamago_04

entries.text: Your Boxes are already full, so the Egg was\ndonated to the academy.
